mapper.select:
SELECT TARGET_ID id, TARGET_NAME text FROM OPT_TARGET_INFO
TARGET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR TARGET_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%'))
select max(TRADE_ID) from WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL where WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId}

select trdDealTotalAdd.ENTRUST_ID, finTradeProduct.CONTRACT_NO, finTradeProduct.HOLD_PURPOSE, /*持有目的*/ finTradeProduct.CONTRACT_NAME, fpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID, fpdt.FPRICE_AMT, finRateInfoStructure.STRUCTURE_TYPE, finTradeProduct.EXC_PS, finTradeProduct.CALENDAR_ID, fpdt.TRADE_DATE, fpdt.PAY_DATE, finTradeProduct.TERM, fpdt.VDATE, fpdt.MDATE, finTradeProduct.CCY, finTradeProduct.PRIN, finRateInfo.BENCHMARK_ID, finRateInfoStructure.EXE_PRICE, finRateInfoStructure.KNOCK_PRICE, finRateInfoStructure.LOW_HIND_PRICE, finRateInfoStructure.LOW_EXERC_PRICE, finRateInfoStructure.HIGH_HIND_PRICE, finRateInfoStructure.HIGH_EXERC_PRICE, finRateInfoStructure.EXEC_BASE_DATE, finExerciseRule.EXERCISE_TYPE, finTradeProductAdd.OPT_FEE_PAY_TYPE, finTradeProductAdd.OPT_FEE_RATE, fpdt.TRADER, fpdt.COUNTER_ID, fpdt.COUNTER_TRADER, fpdt.COUNTER_CONTACT, fpdt.REMARK from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL fpdt left join TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD trdDealTotalAdd on fpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = trdDealTotalAdd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT finTradeProduct on fpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = finTradeProduct.FINPROD_ID and finTradeProduct.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0} left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE finProductType on fpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = finProductType.FINPROD_ID and finProductType.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0} left join FIN_RATE_INFO finRateInfo on finRateInfo.FINPROD_ID = fpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join FIN_CASH_INFO T on T.FINPROD_ID = fpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID and T.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_02} left join FIN_RATE_INFO_STRUCTURE finRateInfoStructure on finRateInfoStructure.CASH_ID = T.CASH_ID left join FIN_EXERCISE_RULE finExerciseRule on finExerciseRule.FINPROD_ID = fpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID and finExerciseRule.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0} left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT_ADD finTradeProductAdd on fpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = finTradeProductAdd.FINPROD_ID
fpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

select count(1) from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL where (TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or P_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) and (IS_CANCEL = #{YES_NO_YES,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_03,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
select TARGET_TYPE from OPT_TARGET_INFO where TARGET_ID = #{targetId}

select T1.ENTRUST_ID ENTRUST_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.VDATE VDATE, T1.MDATE MDATE, T1.CCY CCY, T2.ASSET_TYPE_10 BENCHMARK_ID, T2.ASSET_TYPE_11 STRUCTURE_TYPE, T2.EXERCISE_TYPE EXERCISE_TYPE, T2.EXEC_BASE_DATE EXEC_BASE_DATE, T2.OPT_FEE_PAY_TYPE OPT_FEE_PAY_TYPE, T2.OPT_FEE_PAY_TYPE2*100 OPT_FEE_RATE, T2.EXE_PRICE EXE_PRICE, T2.KNOCK_PRICE KNOCK_PRICE, T2.LOW_HIND_PRICE LOW_HIND_PRICE, T2.LOW_EXERC_PRICE LOW_EXERC_PRICE, T2.HIGH_HIND_PRICE HIGH_HIND_PRICE, T2.HIGH_EXERC_PRICE HIGH_EXERC_PRICE, T2.BUSI_PS EXC_PS, T1.ENTRUST_NUM PRIN, T2.TERM_DAYS TERM, T1.CALENDAR_ID CALENDAR_ID, T3.TRADER TRADER, T1.COUNTER_ID COUNTER_ID, T1.COUNTER_TRADER COUNTER_TRADER, T1.CONTACT_INFO COUNTER_CONTACT, T1.REMARK REMARK from ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T3 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T3.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN OPT_TARGET_INFO T4 ON T2.ASSET_TYPE_10 = T4.TARGET_ID
T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
